description: Q.11 a.3 first-proof reading: transport each God’s individuating basis through suppositum/nature identity to the common divine nature, then apply the explicit incommunicability principle. Equality of beings is derived, not assumed; no maximality, perfection, naming converse, or excluded middle is used. The three principles remain sourced but undefended. Its Comparator config also checks the frozen auxiliary conditional maximalityFromNamedMaximumAndUniqueness from a named maximal witness and GodIsOne; this is not a registered global bridge or an unconditional naming converse.
